description: Notion is a collaborative workspace product for documents, wikis, databases, projects, and related productivity workflows. It also offers enterprise administration features, an AI-agent MCP server, and developer tooling for integrating with workspace content and automation.
summary: Notion exposes a REST API at `api.notion.com`, an Enterprise-only Admin API at `api.notion.com/admin`, a hosted MCP server at `mcp.notion.com` (streamable HTTP and SSE), and the `ntn` CLI; all require authentication via Notion-issued tokens or OAuth.
